title: S7 Delivery, Issue Context and Decision-State Reference

entries.name: CDE Information States
entries.note: These are information-container lifecycle states, not generic approval or acceptance states.

entries.name: Deliverable Issue Contexts
states: Formal Submission / Issued for Declared Use
entries.note: Issue labels declare context and intended use; they do not create authority or prove acceptance.

entries.name: Information Decision Classes
entries.note: Decision classes remain distinct from CDE states and platform workflow statuses. A project may combine decision events only where the governing authority basis explicitly does so.

deprecated_semantics.reason: Deprecated as an unqualified generic gateway state because it collapses multiple decision types. Use the applicable governed decision class instead.

Not a universal enterprise decision state. It may be used as a project-defined issue/purpose code only when its meaning, permitted reliance, decision prerequisites, and authority basis are explicitly governed.
Not evidence of handover acceptance or operational reliance by label alone. Treat as a project-defined record/submission context unless the applicable handover decision is separately evidenced.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 curator reconciliation replaces the legacy generic coordination gateway-state list with explicit decision classes and preserves information state, issue context, decision state, and authority as separate concepts.
